d:
Vo ab bhi hai.
He still is.
The seventh song for Indra, and this one is in plain Hindustani, the language most of us actually speak.
It is the middle of the night and the moon has set. A young man wakes to a gust of wind that seems to be saying something. He lights a lamp and sets out a cup for a god everyone has forgotten. Later he runs barefoot into the dark because he is sure someone called his name. It was only the wind. He laughs at himself, and he keeps the light anyway.
People have been asking this for over three thousand years.
